start.title: Apply to join the PA Compact
start.intro: Your state of qualifying license reviews your application. You'll get an email when it decides.
start.residenceHint: Where you live. It can be in a different state from your license. Legal papers can be sent to you here by mail.
start.stateHint: A state in the compact where you hold a full and unrestricted PA license. If there's more than one, choose any of them.
start.otherNames: Other names you use or have used (optional)

statements.title: Statements and submit
statements.heading: Statements
statements.backgroundCheck: To join the PA Compact, submit to a criminal background check, including fingerprints, through {{state}}'s process within 60 days of applying.

received.heading: Application received
received.applied: You applied on {{date}}. {{state}} will review it next.
received.next1: {{state}} checks your license against its records.
received.next2: To join the PA Compact, submit to a criminal background check, including fingerprints, through {{state}}'s process within 60 days of applying.
received.next3: If {{state}} needs more information, {{state}} will contact you.
received.next4: If {{state}} confirms you're eligible, PA Compact will email you. Then you can apply for Compact Privileges to practice in other states, and pay their fees.

errors.heading: There is a problem
errors.load: We couldn't load your application. Try again later.
errors.save: We couldn't save your answers. Try again.
errors.stateNotLive: That state isn't taking applications. Choose another state.
errors.statementsChanged: A statement changed since you read it. Read the statements again and check each one.
errors.otherNameLastName: Enter a last name for the other name, or leave the other name blank.
